text:
Marta (Design): short pickup: reworking the empty-state and post-create microcopy for API keys. goal: fewer confused users who assume the token is stored and can be revealed later. want quick takes.
Ishaan (PM): Nice. Can you summarise the UX change in one sentence?
Marta (Design): Show a focused post-create panel that combines a one-time reveal, an explicit 'visibility' label, and an action row: Copy / Download / Set permissions. Emphasize ephemeral vs recorded.
Ruth (Eng): Implementation note: making 'recorded' an option requires storing retrievable secret and audit hooks. It'll need infra changes. For ephemeral we keep the current show-once drawer.
Kai (A11y): Important: the post-create panel must announce via aria-live that the token is visible only now. If copy succeeds, announce "Token copied" and trap focus inside the panel until closed.
Marta (Design): Copy draft for the panel header: "Token revealed — this is the only time you'll see it." Subtext: "Copy now or download .env (contains token). To allow team review, enable 'Recorded' in visibility settings."
Ishaan (PM): Default visibility should be Ephemeral. We can surface Recorded behind an advanced toggle to reduce mistakes. Also add a docs link in the toast for audit implications.
Ruth (Eng): Agreed on default. For Recorded, we'll add two flags on create: visibility=recorded and audit=true. Marking as infra-impacting; infra-bot, FYI.
infra-bot: infra-bot: "Flagging epic-912 token-visibility: KMS ACL + audit-storage required."
Marta (Design): UX nit: avoid extra clicks for power users. Primary action is Copy, secondary is Download. A tertiary chevron opens visibility toggles and permission scope.
Kai (A11y): Download action should announce filename and must be reachable via keyboard. Provide a visible close button with accessible name. Don't auto-dismiss to avoid screen reader users missing it.
Ishaan (PM): Rotation flow: propose a small inline 'Keep old token active' slider in the rotate modal. Default off. If enabled show 'Grace period: 24h (recommended)'.
Ruth (Eng): Backend supports configurable grace windows; we'll emit distinct audit events for soft vs hard revoke. UI should show status chips on the list: Active / Revoked (soft) / Revoked (hard).
Marta (Design): Status chips need brief tooltips: e.g., "Revoked (soft) — undoable for 24h". Keep chips compact to preserve row density.
Kai (A11y): Tooltips must be keyboard focusable and not color-only. Chips should include text and aria-labels like "Revoked soft, undoable for 24 hours".
Ishaan (PM): Action items: Marta posts a low-fi frame with panel + rotate modal, Ruth sends a rough backend estimate, Kai writes the a11y checklist, I'll book a 20m security quick-check.
Marta (Design): Posting frames in channel in ~45m. thanks! :sparkles:
